name: everyinfra-router
description: EveryInfra API router for data, source-bound cleanup, search, AI, captcha, email, number and proxy workflows with live discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Route data, cleanup, search and agent infrastructure APIs
interface.longDescription: EveryInfra Router selects among structured data, source-bound cleanup, web search, AI, authorized captcha, email, phone-number and proxy workflows, then checks the live MCP or REST contract before execution. It keeps discovery, account entitlement and external actions separate.
defaultPrompt: I need public data about a set of businesses. Decide whether this is an EveryData or EverySearch task; inspect capabilities before proposing calls.
For this EveryData result, discover source-bound cleanup and show selectable fields before any submit.
Plan a workflow to find current product documentation and draft an email summary. Do not send the email or buy anything.
